card.name: Dosing and storage table wording
card.fires_on: Words in dosing and storage sections that sit just before a dose figure, frequency or temperature. Examples are 'daily' after 'once', the end of 'Infection' or 'Refrigerated', and 'at' in 'Store at'.

modes.label: Frequency words
modes.description: The word 'daily' closing a dosing phrase such as 'once daily'.
modes.example: Recommended dosage range is 5 mg to 40 mg once<< daily>>. ( 2.2 ) Pediatric

modes.label: Table header words
modes.description: The end of a word in a dosing table heading, such as 'Infection' or 'Inhibitor'.
modes.example: Site and Type of In<<fection>> Dose Frequency Moderate to severe infections

modes.label: Storage wording
modes.description: 'Refrigerated' or 'Store at' just before a temperature range.

card.plain: It fires on the last piece of a dosing or storage heading, just before the numbers come.
